items.title: Russian Hackers Exploit Zimbra Zero-Day Against US, Ukraine Targets
items.description: A state-sponsored threat group, dubbed "Laundry Bear," sends "half-click" phishing emails that require a victim only to open or preview the message.

items.title: New Dolphin X malware uses AI to rank high-value targets
items.description: A new Dolphin X remote access trojan claims to use an AI-powered profiling feature to score and rank infected users, helping cybercriminals identify which victims should be targeted first. [...]

items.title: Australian energy provider Origin says data breach exposes client data
items.description: Origin Energy has confirmed that an unauthorized party accessed and subsequently leaked customer data online, exposing sensitive personally identifiable information (PII), among others. [...]

items.title: Fake Claude app promoted by Bing ads pushes SectopRAT malware
items.description: A malvertising campaign on the Bing search service is pushing a fake Claude desktop app installer hosted on a legitimate Claude.ai domain to deliver the SectopRAT malware. [...]

items.title: Russian Espionage Group Exploited Zimbra Zero-Day to Steal Mail and 2FA Codes
items.description: A Russian state-supported espionage group spent months reading Western mailboxes through a then-unknown flaw in Zimbra's webmail client. The payload goes after the last 90 days of email, the organization's entire email directory, the password saved in the browser and the codes kept for two-factor recovery. items.title: Hackers Abuse Notepad++ Plugins to Compromise Your System Silently
items.description: A stealthy new campaign in which the UAC-0099 threat cluster hijacks a legitimate Notepad++ plugin to quietly plant malware on victim machines, marking a significant evolution in the group’s tactics since mid-summer 2026. items.title: Russian hackers exploit Zimbra zero-click flaw for email theft
items.description: CISA is warning that the Russian state-sponsored hacking group Laundry Bear, also known as Void Blizzard, is targeting organizations using Zimbra Collaboration email servers by combining phishing attacks with the exploitation of a now-patched Zimbra vulnerability. [...]

items.title: ThreatsDay: Android Spyware, PLC Attacks, AI Image Prompt Injection + 12 More Stories
items.description: Most of this week's trouble came dressed as something useful. A package stole data. A fake extension opened remote access. A safety app became spyware. An image gave hidden orders to an AI agent. Other threats hid in open systems, weak code, and normal network traffic. The threats change every week. items.title: ZDI-CAN-30553: Trend Micro
items.description: A CVSS score 7.8 AV:L/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H severity vulnerability discovered by 'Lays (@_L4ys) of TRAPA Security' was reported to the affected vendor on: 2026-07-23, 0 days ago. The vendor is given until 2026-11-20 to publish a fix or workaround. Once the vendor has created and tested a patch we will coordinate the release of a public advisory.

items.title: Ransomware Attack Puts a Chill on Japanese Frozen-Food Chain
items.description: A cyberattack on a food and logistics firm disrupts the supply of frozen food to thousands of clients, including major franchises like Kentucky Fried Chicken.
